## [1.1.0](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/ck-zombies-morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-09-26)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Hide the daily offline bonus message ([f0f822a](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/ck-zombies-morphe-patches/commit/f0f822ae1a4e64f94c03ed091bbb931d09a4c7ad))

### ✨ New Features

* Play the intro video only once ([3904c50](https://github.com/ComoEstaisAmigos/ck-zombies-morphe-patches/commit/3904c50d4c4a3b2723ea24434a0bc53a52948026))

patches.name: Modern Android compatibility
patches.description: Fixes the crash at launch on current Android and targets API 25 so that Android 14 and later install the game normally. The game is 32-bit only, so the device must still run 32-bit apps.

patches.name: Play intro once
patches.description: Plays the intro video on the first launch after installing, and skips it after that.

patches.name: Remove unused permissions
patches.description: Removes permissions the game no longer needs, such as phone and accounts, along with the dead services that needed them.

patches.name: Smooth sound
patches.description: Removes the stutter while firing, caused by the game building a new audio player for every sound.

patches.name: Stop requests to dead servers
patches.description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers.

patches.name: Unlimited currency
patches.description: A fresh install starts with 999,999,999 Glu credits and 999,999,999 Cash. If you install the patched app as an update, your current balance stays as it is.
